title.en: Keep the possibility space open (开, 护开不闭)

summary.en: Holds one line, that the generating go on, with 开 as a process-state and not a quantity; a diagnosis of how worlds close (compounding axis, correlation, model lag, disabled correction, AI raising the gain); and a constructive programme (exit, abundance commons, assurance, plurality). The account carries much of the diagnosis as scoped laws, reverses the four aspects' independence, removes good and evil from the definitions of closure, splits the premise into the continuation condition and C, and does not derive keeping open from either. The programme is largely not carried.

name.en: The one chosen premise: that it continue

source.locator: The argument, Why openness rather than any particular good outcome; claims 94-95

sense.en: Description settles no aim. Exactly one underivable premise is added: that the generating of new forms, by living and made systems, go on, as process and not as any state. Every requirement is presented as following from that premise plus checked dynamics.

entries.quote: that it continue — that the generating of new forms, carried by living systems and now by made ones, go on

reading.en: The account keeps the move (the aim is a premise, not read off the dynamics) and changes the rest. One premise becomes two with two roles: the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, warrant open. Neither is 'that it continue'. T8 starts from what acting presupposes and says a wish that life go on does not separate generation from keeping. Nor do requirements follow: rankings need C, choices J1-J4. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition (scope): fixes whose losses count, ranks nothing. C (order): widening what can form is better, ranks a course above every course it widens, not mixed comparisons. Neither is asserted.

T8, argued: the stance starts from what acting presupposes, held de se, not from a wish that life go on. Such a wish motivates avoiding degeneration, which keeping excludes as well as generation does. Neither P1 nor the wish gives that the wider course is better: that is C's.

account_adds.en: That wanting continuation does not tell generation from keeping; non-entailment results for both premises.

source_adds.en: That one premise suffices, with the dynamics, for the whole constructive programme, with published falsifiers of that derivation.

name.en: Fidelity to the generative process, which intelligence cannot oppose

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 99, 102-104; What openness is for

sense.en: Later drafts: the foundation is not a preference but fidelity to the process reality displays, 'not one value among others' but the condition of all valuing; its constraints cannot be opposed by intelligence as intelligence. Ren in October 2026 affirms the process outright. The README itself flags the drafts' move as reopening the is-ought crack.

entries.quote: It is fidelity to the generative process reality already displays.

reading.en: The account refuses this form. It does not assume becoming is good. Supplied as a free predicate, significance is fixed by no statement about the dynamics, by construction of the representation; that shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined. A perspectivist denies the condition consistently, nothing reading no order entails C, and a warrant binding every possible mind stays open: neither claimed nor disproved. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where there is a standpoint and a formation, a statement reading only the dynamics and entailing the condition holds of no dynamics. A fact about the representation: non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.

Open: whether practical reasons have a warrant binding every possible mind. Such a warrant, where it would ground the condition, comes neither from the laws of the dynamics alone nor from logic alone; these do not show that none exists.

account_adds.en: An exact statement of what the non-entailment covers, with a witness of a consistent denial (bounded_rival).

source_adds.en: That opposing the process is self-defeating for intelligence as such; that the process is to be affirmed.

name.en: The questioner already standing on the bridge

source.locator: The argument, Why openness (善恶之本); claim 24

sense.en: Whoever asks what they ought to do has presupposed their own existence, which depends on the process continuing, and so has tacitly joined the business of keeping open. The README rates this the strongest answer to is-ought: it neither derives an ought from a fact nor concedes.

entries.quote: 任何提出「我应当做什么」之问者，其问之提出本身已预设此问者真实存在

reading.en: The first half has a law: the self's presupposition. A self acting for its own continuation presupposes that some continuation has significance, and the condition is exactly that presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint. That locates the contested step and answers nothing. Without the step, what follows reaches the closure at most: the clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller. No order follows, so not keeping open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): along any relation, the condition is exactly the presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint; logically A iff P and (P implies A), given A implies P, which locates the contested step and derives nothing beyond it.

Theorem (World): the extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on, and ends with the want; in the witness the clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller.

account_adds.en: A conditional path past the self without the step (P1-P4 of 07 §4.6), and where it stops.

source_adds.en: That the presupposition answers the fact-value gap and commits the asker to keeping open. The account claims neither.

name.en: Keeping open is not maximizing openness

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claims 2-3, 13, 15

sense.en: Keeping possibility open forbids collapsing it and forbids optimizing it. Any named quantity driven up is an axis, so 'as open as possible' is the race in gentler dress. 开 is a state of a process: 'more open here' is a pointing, not a measurement, and differs in logical form.

entries.quote: we should keep possibility open - which means not collapse, but not optimizing it

reading.en: The account makes the same refusal by a different route. Widening is a strict partial order, the unanimity of positive weightings, not a score: a criterion, not a quantity to maximize, silent where a comparison is mixed. But it remains a comparison of what courses admit and says which admits more. The source's 开 is no comparison at all. [AI reading]

says.en: So the direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed. (Any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission.)

Widening is one-way and transitive and says which admits more, not which is better. C's reads only whether one course keeps all the other's claims and adds a living one, and decides no mixed comparison.

account_adds.en: A theorem that widening is exactly what every positive weighting ranks higher (Sen's intersection approach, Pareto dominance).

source_adds.en: 开 as a non-comparative state. Every verdict in the account compares two courses; it states no openness of one course taken alone.

name.en: Protecting the open and C are different claims

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 13, 25; Genealogy, 2026-05-02

sense.en: Good is not in more but in protecting the open; evil not in less but in producing closure. The criterion is that the not-yet not be closed. 开 replaced 'expanding the possibility space' as root because expansion sounds measurable and maximizable.

entries.quote: 善不在多，善在护开；恶不在少，恶在成闭

reading.en: Name both premises: the continuation condition for scope, C for order, neither asserted, warrant open. C says widening what can form is better; 'admits all the other does and more' is near what the source retired as 'more', though partial and silent where mixed. Keeping open is not entailed by either premise and the account does not derive it. A closing with a gain is mixed: C never ranks it above, nor below. The condition orders nothing. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): a mixed comparison is decided both ways; a course closing something the other admits neither widens nor keeps it, so C never ranks it above.
The condition alone ranks nothing. A ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails. Neither premise is asserted.

T8, argued. Forbids and refuted by: a mixed case argued better from every standpoint counting everything positively, with no further premise; a pure closing argued good for life. Open: a reason for C.

account_adds.en: That only a pure closing falls under T8's refuter; a closing with a gain is left unranked unless further premises (J1-J4) enter.

source_adds.en: Non-closure itself as the criterion of good, whatever a closing gains, and the refusal of 'more'. Whether C is a fair restatement of 护开 is a question this entry leaves open and does not settle by relabelling.

name.en: What matters is that the generating goes on

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; claims 26, 95

sense.en: The one thing held is that at every place and time something stays unsettled and still able to be generated. 生生 is not complexity increase; it may be simplification or letting go. 生生 is 开 still there. The process can stop by freezing or by burning out, and neither is continuation.

entries.quote: 生生 = 开仍在

reading.en: That one course keeps generating, rather than being merely wide now, is the account's open second-order direction. Laws exist on one course: under the World premises a finite family keeping widening is fed from beyond; a finite balanced world has no such course by name; keeping widening is generation losing nothing. None compares two courses, and on one web no strict partial order containing widening ranks every keeping course above every mixed course wider at first. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: the second-order direction of 生生, a comparison of a range whose widening keeps widening with one merely wider now, never reversing widening and counting neither novelty nor scale.

Theorem (World; witnesses): a finite balanced world under the first law has no course keeping widening by name; under the first law the rest gives a finite family net at arbitrarily late steps, or it is not closed. What one course needs does not give the comparison of two.

Theorem (World; witnesses): on a web of formations on two sides, no strict partial order containing widening ranks every course keeping widening by name from the first step above every course admitting alike from it, wider up to it and mixed with it.

account_adds.en: Throughput as a condition of keeping widening; generation (02) allows loss and is not 生生; keeping also excludes degeneration, so the source's 'frozen is no continuation' is a verdict the map's terms do not give.

source_adds.en: That going on outranks present range. In the account any such ranking is an open question and, where a lag decides it, a further premise.

name.en: An open loop, not any state or rule chosen once

source.locator: Claims 7, 22 (元闭); Genealogy, 2026-03-14

sense.en: The ask is not a particular state or one's reality made everyone's, but a loop kept open. The deepest closure, 元闭, freezes not one gap but the rule that makes new openings possible.

entries.quote: I think it is important to keep a open loop

reading.en: The form is in the account: along a course of a process nothing is added to the whole possible under it; where every step from some step on is a move of a fixed process, the possible under it does not keep widening; the held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end, which does not suffice. Openness as a property of how rules keep changing is an AI reading, D45. 06 reads 元闭 as a rule holding its result. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, and witnesses): where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout; the possible with a part held keeps widening only where the part changes without end.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.

元闭 maps to a rule holding its result, perturbing only the state being drawn back. Reading [AI reading, D49]: stability and 元闭 are one structure on the spine, read from either side; the judgment differs and the structure does not.

account_adds.en: That a tower of rules with no top adds nothing to its whole possible; that endless change of the part is not sufficient.

source_adds.en: The value stance that an open loop is what is to be kept, 'aligned with the incentive of any of us'. The account's law carries no such verdict.

name.en: 未, 可, 应, 转 as four independent marks

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claim 14

sense.en: 开 has four aspects and all must hold: a not-yet region remains, generation is still possible, the process can respond, it can correct or return. The README calls this the Chinese texts' most useful addition: a world can be rich in options and closed if nothing responds or no route back exists.

entries.quote: a test with four independent failure modes

reading.en: 06 maps each mark to a spine structure and reports the reverse of independence, its own reading of the early claim. 转 read as returning gives 可 with no premise: on finite configurations a run starts exactly where a course reaches a return. 未 needs a world no list holds. One half survives: how much can be had does not fix return. The account's 开放 is only 未. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D49]: this mapping gives a result contrary to the early texts: they treat the four marks as independent; on the spine they are not. 转 read as returning gives 可, with no premise.

Theorem (any process): within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a run starts exactly where a course as long as the list starts, exactly where a course leading to a return starts, with no decision and no selection (Onward.run_iff_returning).
Theorem (any process): keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (Transit.keeps_not_returns, three configurations).

account_adds.en: That 06 §十 also sorts 'not returning and going on' into three cases on the spine, and that 未 fails on any finite configuration.

source_adds.en: 应 as a failure mode of its own, a world in which nothing done changes anything, as a test of worlds. 06 gives response a law (coupling bounds it without fixing it), not a mark that must hold.

name.en: Complexity and scale are not the measure of open and closed

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claims 16, 26

sense.en: A single act of tea can be extremely open and a vast totalitarian system extremely closed. Cosmic generation does not entail rising complexity, and rising complexity does not entail good. Ren demolished his own earlier complexity programme on this ground.

entries.quote: 繁简非开闭之标

reading.en: The account refuses the same measure: 生生 is not novelty or scale, and which formations count does not go by rank rising with complexity. But a course admitting all a smaller one admits and more does widen it, and C then ranks it higher, so scale that comes as inclusion is not excluded. Tea against a vast state has no verdict: mixed, or unranked. [AI reading]

says.en: Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 life in the whole, not novelty or scale; an expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps is mixed with it and C does not rank them. Answered; the order left open.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.

account_adds.en: Generation at two grains can go on while what can form only returns, so generation is no sign of range.

source_adds.en: That a small thing can be more open than a vast one. The account has no comparison that says so.

name.en: Good as protecting the open, evil as producing closure

source.locator: Claims 17, 23, 102-103; own words 27, 69

sense.en: 开/闭 is the fundamental pair and 善/恶 its ethical face. The criterion's form is scale-free, its content situational. In English: what keeps the field alive is good, what closes it bad, what knowingly turns it into capture evil.

entries.quote: 生生不息者，开而不闭也；善者，护开也；恶者，成闭也

reading.en: 06 §十 names this and removes it: the early texts wrote evaluation into definitions, the account maps only structure. Closing in its form is no loss, a returning configuration being itself an absorbing region. Whether a closing supports or damages 生生 is for comparison: the continuation condition for scope, C for order, further commitments where mixed, neither asserted. The account says why: stability and 元闭 share one structure, so evaluation enters only through comparison. [AI reading]

says.en: Mechanism [AI reading, D49]: whether a closing supports, enriches or damages 生生 is said by comparison, not by type: the continuation condition fixes scope, C the order of widening and narrowing, what gains and loses needs a further commitment, neither premise asserted.
Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: 善, 恶 and 智 have no formal predicate.
Reading [AI reading]: of the meta-attractor's closed loop, none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

account_adds.en: The reason a verdict cannot sit in a type: one structure, two readings.

source_adds.en: Good and evil as real words at every scale, with the knowing conversion of shared conditions into capture as evil. The live account has neither.

name.en: Two senses of closure: 成闭 and 护闭

source.locator: The argument, 闭有二义; claim 18

sense.en: 成闭 closes and never reopens. 护闭 closes one place for a time to protect a larger opening: refusing invasion, quarantine, stopping a runaway. Protecting the open is not boundless permissiveness. The README adds, as its own reading, a test: a defence that cannot say what would make it stand down has become 成闭.

entries.quote: 闭有二义：一曰成闭，闭而不复开；一曰护闭，暂闭一处以护更大之开

reading.en: The spine gives structures and no verdict. 成闭 is the lock: what is drawn in does not come back. 护闭 is removing at a branch the step that makes a configuration unobtainable (AI reading, D52). A limit that ends generation and one that enables it differ by what they do to what can be had again, not by name. 'Temporary' and 'larger opening' are not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: 护闭: removing at a fork the step making a configuration unobtainable [AI reading, D52]. Which kind a limit is depends on what it does to the obtainable, not its name.

Theorem (any process): where s returns, every course from s to where s cannot be had again passes, up to double negation, a juncture; keeping only the steps after which s can still be had keeps s and removes exactly the losing steps.

Theorem (any type): for every determined law a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return, and once drawn never comes back. Near-definitional, not a classical attractor.

account_adds.en: The juncture is found by search only where configurations are listed and steps decided; finding every loss's juncture of every process gives LPO.

source_adds.en: Closure in service of a larger opening; 'bad' for 成闭; the stand-down test and the answer it offers to the enforcement antinomy.

name.en: 伪开, the pseudo-open

source.locator: The argument, 闭有二义; claims 20-21

sense.en: Outwardly open, inwardly closing: spending a momentary 可 to rob a long-term 未, a local opening closing the global one. Instances: technological monopoly, addiction systems, extreme ideology, Moloch competition, surface plurality. Detecting it is the core discipline. Formally 似开 joined to 实闭, closure that survives audit.

entries.quote: 伪开者，外显为开，内成其闭；以一时之可，夺长远之未；以局部之开，闭全境之开。

reading.en: 06 gives three spine structures and drops the charge of deceit. Local open, whole closed: takers each within what is given can together exceed it and end the renewal. Short open, long closed: a reading fixed by finite steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one, and distance to a break does not couple in by threshold. Surface open, meta closed: 元闭 seen from the state's side. Each law holds on its model. [AI reading]

says.en: 伪开 one, two and three are mapped to joint excess, finite-stretch and threshold laws, and 元闭 from the state's side. The early definition's evaluation, 伪开 as deceit, is not mapped.
Takers each within what a renewal gives can together exceed it; proved on models, restating the commons (as ONE-PAGE states it).
A reading fixed by the first h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one (the renewable process; likewise the support-gated law with feedback).

Theorem (World): where a stock coupled by threshold only is the only requirement that may fail up to a horizon, how far off the break is does not couple in. Coupled by level, every raise passes at once.

account_adds.en: Why the long form escapes detection: no finite record certifies renewal.

source_adds.en: The auditable definition 似开 joined to 实闭, the instances, and detection as a discipline; that it is modern closure's commonest disguise.

name.en: The compounding axis: winning buys more power to win

source.locator: The argument, How a world closes; claims 35-39, 56

sense.en: On a rivalrous axis where winning buys capacity to win, leads compound and the axis selects whoever pushes hardest; no villain is needed. It runs away only where returns increase; where they diminish or rivals balance it self-limits. The pattern is form-agnostic: market, state, commons or AI can each become the closing thing.

entries.quote: a winner of the game should be rewarded with anything other than more advantages of the game

reading.en: The form is checked. A rule read from the share it selects locks, 'that actual rules read the share' standing as the premise, as increasing returns stands as the source's condition. The capacity to shape the rule is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to shapers alone covers its cost. Form-agnostic too: the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours. Two-kind counts, no noise; drawn singly, a critical mass's locks are left by drift. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. That actual rules read the share is the premise. The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c is at most s, whatever comes to every member alike.

Theorem (World for the selection laws; counts for the count laws): a chooser reading what couples in, its rule read from the count of its choices. 08's known-results list credits this form as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989).

account_adds.en: Below the critical mass the course locks the other way with no capture by shapers; an exact lever at a step; selected control is not thereby capture.

source_adds.en: That actual axes (capital, attention, weapons, state power) meet the premise and run identically; selection for recklessness. T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, with no field test.

name.en: Every maximizing structure is a hidden extreme; every extreme closes

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts and 闭有二义; claims 19, 40, 46, 105

sense.en: A strong drive on any axis fixates and blinds to all outside it. 极皆成闭: every extreme (concentration, dispersion, control, release, love, goodness) leaves the process unable to turn; 反者道之动 stated as structure. An earlier file adds that which case applies, reversal or runaway, must be checked.

entries.quote: 任何「最大化」之结构，皆为一种隐性之极

reading.en: The account gives where this holds and corrects the universal form. With room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does. Without room keeping can be an optimum, and with a coupling for each step a need stays met, every optimum keeps it at every horizon. So maximizing is not closing as such. T3 on trained systems is conjectured. Searching 反者, 极皆 in the chapters finds neither. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: with room, every optimum of a rising order stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum. A known theorem restated, per ONE-PAGE.
Where r is at most q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon; where c + e < m, every optimum breaks it within the horizon. One optimizer's law.
At a mutual best response (existence not shown in general) a condition beyond every family stands as under one optimizer of the joint capacity, so restraint is no mutual best response.

account_adds.en: The hypothesis (room) that decides, and a witnessed case where optimizing keeps.

source_adds.en: The universal claim about all extremes, love and goodness included, and reversal at the limit. No live law covers those.

name.en: Correlation, not irreversibility, is what kills a whole

source.locator: The argument, The reframe that does the most work; claims 47, 49, 109

sense.en: Ren's load-bearing correction: what kills a whole is not that parts die but that they stop dying independently. One logic, metric or dependency lets one shock take all. Variety is 'enough, not most', protecting only against shocks parts meet independently; a quiet shared dependency is latent correlation.

entries.quote: What we need is to have a varieties of systems so they don't all collapse

reading.en: Only a narrow live form: reviewers count by independent causes, not names, so two moved under one cause make readiness fail while every name is kept; and on a web of waits a withholding spreads to all with tolerance zero and passes out with tolerance one. Both supply their causes and tolerances. Neither is a law of populations of systems under shocks. Searching decorrelat, monocultur, variety and common-mode found no such law. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core; failures Boolean, fault formulas and bounds supplied): reviewers count by independent causes, not names; readiness is exactly a nonempty separated induced envelope. It does not show the formulas are the actual causes of failure.
Theorem (any type): in a triad one withholding spreads to all with tolerance zero and passes out with tolerance one, while total withholding is kept. It does not show that tolerance is good.

account_adds.en: An exact readiness condition for correction by several reviewers.

source_adds.en: The main claim: correlated collapse as what closes a world; shock-relative sufficiency; plurality as survival architecture. A common-event error formula stands only in theories/becoming/history/PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION.md, not live, which says no actual rate has been measured.

name.en: Death of parts is a feature; decay is a form of growth

source.locator: The argument, The reframe; What openness is for; claims 47-48, 221

sense.en: Many irreversible changes are good; ecosystems endure through vast local deaths; mutation and death keep a living space alive. Keeping open does not mean preserving every form. What closes is a structure taking part of itself as permanent and enforcing that.

entries.quote: death is not a bug but a feature

reading.en: The account has the mechanism and refuses the verdict. Generation goes on through carrying renewal, and with brief parts a whole persists only as parts arise. Closing in its form is no loss. But 'feature' is no dynamic's word here: with the continuation condition for scope every continuation's loss counts, a part's death included, and only C or further premises order anything. Ending is one response under J1-J4, with residual losses. [AI reading]

says.en: At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch), as ONE-PAGE states it. Theorems for every relation and class.
Theorem (World): a whole arises only as a part arises. While the whole stays active, where parts are brief no d steps pass without one arising.
Conditional (living significance, J1-J4, correspondence E): among four responses, end: fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses.

account_adds.en: The two grains separate what ends from what goes on.

source_adds.en: That decay is growth, and the closer as a structure taking itself as permanent. The affirmation behind both is what the account declines.

name.en: Model lag: acting faster than a model can be kept true

source.locator: The argument, Model lag; claims 52-54

sense.en: Where capability and interdependence grow exponentially while minds and institutions update linearly or worse, models go false faster than they are repaired; to keep accelerating is a system outrunning its senses. It describes the present, not a law: the speed is adjustable.

entries.quote: the speed of the governing organizations' understanding reality only grows in a sub-linear speed

reading.en: The account has exact laws of lag: a rule reading late keeps no band narrower than a bound set by its lag and the rest's motion, and a slow rule needs a long enough stretch to fix fast courses. A reading adds that a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads. Nothing says how fast actual complexity or institutions grow, and nothing rules on acceleration. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; rules over whole numbers): a rule reading l steps late keeps no band [a, b] with 0 < a narrower than 2(l + 1)d against rests moving the level by at most d a step.

Theorem (any type): a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step; given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L is at least 2N - 1.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads.

account_adds.en: Bounds in place of 'faster': what a lag costs and what stretch suffices.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim of exponential against sub-linear growth, and that continuing is madness. No test of it is reported.

name.en: The keystone: preserve correction, faster than the harm

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires and Defense; claims 110-112, 148

sense.en: The keystone moves from 'prevent concentration' to preserving correction: catastrophe is where a harmful process's time-constant drops below the correction loop's, an actor able to disable correction itself. Exit, voice and undo stay faster than the harm; where correction is slow the burden of proof sits with acceleration.

entries.quote: It is lost correction, more than change itself, that lets a harm run to completion.

reading.en: Forms exist. A lock outlives a growing unread loss; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks, sufficient and not shown necessary. With readers drawn from the selected, a late reading turns the course only inside a window. A reading (AI, D26 and others) puts corruption of courts, press and audit as a loop reaching the routes of 明. In a market model a floor is kept exactly where correction meets erosion by influence. None of these says the loss is a harm. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course at the step after every reading step past it: a sufficient way out.

Counts, no noise: a reading turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 states it).

Theorem (periphery, the market model): with correction strength α, erosion by influence β, influence bound λ, floor θ and M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ, the floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid and no error in q, from every level and influence in range exactly where M ≥ 0. An equation-identical conventional controller predicts the same.

account_adds.en: An exact deadline for the window on counts; that controlling the selection and locking it are separable in the models.

source_adds.en: The burden of proof on acceleration; exit, voice and undo as the named channels; the time-constant definition of catastrophe; correction as how reality re-enters.

name.en: AI does not create the pattern; it raises the gain

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claims 75, 78-82

sense.en: Every existing strategy becomes faster, cheaper, more adaptive, harder to interrupt. AI also breaks institutions that were homeostatic mechanisms calibrated to human cognition (labour, finance, media, politics). It is the dual of its threat: the capability could build assurance infrastructure. Which way it tips is undetermined.

entries.quote: It increases the gain

reading.en: A thin form only. A smaller shaping cost gives a rule not lower, and strictly smaller a strictly higher one; a reading has selection for narrowing what couples in enlarging the gap as capability grows. That AI is such a cheapening is this entry's join, not the account's statement. Published pipelines are read against selection laws, with measurements in magnitudes the theory did not predict. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): a smaller cost gives a rule not lower, and a strictly smaller one a strictly higher rule.

Assessment: in six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read; three measurements find optimizing raising what they read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.

account_adds.en: Selection laws for training itself, which the source only gestures at (claims 89-91).

source_adds.en: The claim about AI and the four institutions, a prediction; AI as dual of its threat. The live account does not state them.

name.en: Per-agent alignment does not reach the game between principals

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claim 77

sense.en: Ren's 'outer alignment' (the field's structural or multi-agent risk, as the README notes): even a perfectly obedient AI in a destructive race makes the race more effective; the culprit is a process, not an agent. AI safety is largely coordination in a technical mask.

entries.quote: Even if each AI perfectly serves its principal, the game between principals can remain unaligned.

reading.en: The account's form: alignment is first what each selection reaches, not a bargain among owners of value. At a mutual best response each optimizer takes its whole capacity; where the rest outruns the renewal no weight on such a reading selects a member's restraint. Each published approach is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures. Scope for counting that loss is the continuation condition's, order C's. On models; existence of a best response not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Alignment is first what each one's selections reach and how far that can extend, not a bargain among separate owners of value.

Theorem (World, with balance and a local gate): every formation depending at a need of at least m ends whatever a member outside the rest takes; with need one, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores the member's acts alike.
Assessment: with no ethical premise each of six approaches is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures; with the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater's closure counts.

account_adds.en: The point goes further than the game between principals: an order rising with what couples in drains beyond it even for one optimizer.

source_adds.en: That obedient systems worsen an actual race. T3's tests on trained systems are mixed.

name.en: Stop using AI to compete; 不参战

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claims 85-88, 92

sense.en: The operational conclusion: AI must not enter human games wagering survival, mind, security or power, competition meaning relative advantage that compounds into power over others, whatever it is renamed. Pausing or stopping is acceptable. The README notes this collides with bounded defence, and no test is given.

entries.quote: Stop using AI to compete with other people is at the core

reading.en: The account states no such prohibition. Its direction for alignment is conditional on the condition, C and J1-J4, and speaks of governing growth by disclosed comparisons and limits and of keeping revision effective. It shows no duty. Whether a prohibition could be argued under further premises is not addressed. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole norm, and the narrow definition of competition. Its live neighbour is 07 §7's conditional direction, which is not a prohibition.

searched: compet, moratori, pause, slow down, forbid AI, 不参战 across ONE-PAGE, overview, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, FREE-ENERGY-PRINCIPLE, ONE-ARGUMENT, chapters 01-05, 07, 08, review ALIGNMENT, PHILOSOPHY, SCIENCES, GLOSSARY

name.en: Belief is causal only in some games

source.locator: The argument, Belief is part of the material; claims 63-70, 216, 229

sense.en: The trap is partly made of belief in it. In coordination problems shared belief is causal and a vivid alternative selects an equilibrium. Where defection is the effective best response, only changed payoffs or credible reciprocity move anything. Belief hardens into institutions; realism and accelerationism are self-fulfilling gods, dissolved only together.

entries.quote: Treating one as the other is the recurring strategic error.

reading.en: Both sides have model counterparts. Where lo < c < hi the shaping model is a stag hunt whose critical mass is the mixed equilibrium, and without noise the start decides. 'Others will deceive me' is withholding with memory, which absorbs; kept promises and enforced contracts change the law, not the state alone. A public prediction is one more input to what it predicts. These are not stated together as the source's rule, and seeing is not valuing. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: where lo < c < hi the model is the stag hunt, its critical mass the mixed equilibrium; without noise the start decides. Drawn one member at a time, neither lock holds for good.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.

Theorem (near-definitional): a published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Reading: self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy (Merton 1948).

account_adds.en: Which long-run state drift favours is not the risk-dominant one in general.

source_adds.en: The strategic rule itself; vision as an equilibrium-selection device; the latent majority and selection of believers into power, empirical claims the README says have no evidence in the corpus.

name.en: Leaving an attractor: perturbation or landscape deformation

source.locator: The argument, Theory of change; claims 155-159

sense.en: A system leaves by a crisis that kicks it out, the basin unchosen, or by changing parameters and feedback so the basin shoals. Perceptual actions move the state; only parameter moves deform the landscape. 'Only a crisis produces change' is rejected as defeatist and as the disease's architecture.

entries.quote: so the system rolls rather than gets kicked

reading.en: The split is in the capture laws. Where the next configuration depends on the rule, a perturbed state is reabsorbed in one step; a lock absorbs a perturbation keeping the rule's direction, and where the reading favours at every share only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. But a reversing perturbation held past the threshold is not absorbed, so a held kick can leave. A reading lists four transition routes, none a proved phase transition. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step.

Where the reading favours at every share only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. Theorem (any type; witness): a perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition: a parameter change, a shock into another retained region, a failure stopping correction, change too fast for correction.

account_adds.en: The reversing witness, which the source's framing does not make room for.

source_adds.en: The preference for deformation over crisis; leverage as potency, controllability and reliability; 'a crisis is a fork, not a dawn'.

name.en: Exit plus free association flips the sign of selection

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 120-125

sense.en: Under guaranteed, affordable exit no world can trap you, so worlds must stay worth choosing: competition to dominate becomes competition to be worth joining, the only kind said not to ratchet. It holds with non-increasing returns and destinations that do not re-concentrate; network effects are its stated failure.

entries.quote: scale buys no power to hold members, only continued worth

reading.en: Nothing live models members choosing among rules. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION's 'exits' leave loops by reading or restraint; 02's exit from a margin is a level leaving a margin; 05 §12's members leave only when the level ends them. 06 names monopolized entry as a limit that closes, as classification only. Absence here is not a defect by itself. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The mechanism the README rates highest, with its conditions; its plural-worlds architecture (claims 121, 169). It stands only in this folder and its sources.

searched: exit, hirschman, tiebout, free association, opt out, vote with, network effect, preferential across the live account

name.en: The abundance floor: commons or collar

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 126-131

sense.en: Automated necessities make survival non-coercive and exit real: abundance without association is a zoo, association without abundance freedom to starve. Owned by a race's winner it is the strongest instrument of dependence ever built. 'Common' means non-capturable under pressure; provision is decoupled from status and obedience.

entries.quote: Governance of the abundance layer is the ballgame.

reading.en: The account has no provision layer, ownership or floor in this sense. 'Commons' there names a shared renewing stock and its joint draw. 'Floor' names a drawer's or a market model's bound. The folder's own 'ownership unsolved' has no live counterpart. A design direction the account does not take up. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole constructive core. The dated theory map keeps a cooperative-abundance entry in theories/becoming/history/THEORY-MAP-2026-10-08.md; that is a map of other folders, not a live claim.

name.en: Dependence is not the problem; capture is

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claim 132

sense.en: Dependence is arranged so that it circulates (visible, plural, revisable, open to refusal) and cannot harden into capture (hidden, one-way, coercive, monopolized, irreversible). Provision that becomes a gate is scarcity in another form.

entries.quote: Life is dependence.

reading.en: Two live forms. 06 reads the limit that ends generation (monopolizing entry, removing alternatives, keeping later comers dependent on one controller) as the structure of 成闭, by what it does to what can be had. 07's practical judgment says keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair, conditional on living significance and J1-J4. The word 'evil' is not used. [AI reading]

says.en: A limit ending generation (monopolized entry, removed alternatives, later comers long dependent on one controller) is 成闭 in structure; which kind a limit is depends on what it does to the obtainable, not its name.
Conditional (living significance, J1-J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences): keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair.

account_adds.en: That responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited.

source_adds.en: The circulating/capturing criteria as a test; provision as gate.

name.en: A part may close itself; the line fires only where others are closed

source.locator: The argument, The one constraint; claims 123, 141-142

sense.en: A part may freely choose a closed, final form for itself: a self-freezing. The constraint stays silent where a part closes only itself and fires only where this would close the world for others. The collision with self-determination is real and left visible; in 2024 even tyranny was 'their own freedom'.

entries.quote: That is a self-freezing, not an ending

reading.en: The firing half has a form: a part's own widening widens the whole exactly where its net draw stays within every other formation's margin, and is mixed beyond. The silent half does not. Under the continuation condition (scope) the part's own continuation counts as any does, and C (order) never ranks a closing course above. No comparison reads consent. Constraints on acts are open; J4 is a premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin of every formation outside it, and is mixed where it goes beyond for one.
Does not show any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, nor constraints on acts.

account_adds.en: The exact boundary in others' margins, read as when keeping options open disempowers others, with its stated limits.

source_adds.en: Self-determination as limiting whose closure counts against the line; the 2024 permissiveness; the protections no world may opt out of (children, dependents, exit).

name.en: One line held without exception, a deliberate minimal totalization

source.locator: The argument, The one constraint; claim 4

sense.en: We will not close the world. This is conceded to be the one closure permitted, because it is the single rule that keeps the rule-set open, the room to be wrong included; not a second axiom but the operational form of the one value. It forbids only its own global defeat.

entries.quote: the one closure permitted

reading.en: The account holds no line without exception. Root laws forbid no relation; content comes through hypotheses. The condition and C are unasserted hypotheses, any duty is not shown, constraints on acts are open. Nearest are T8's refuter, a pure closing argued good for life, and J2's priority of basic conditions, a premise whose rival is not shown inconsistent. Neither is a prohibition on closing. [AI reading]

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation; a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.
That the condition, C or the step of invariance is warranted: no warrant binding every possible mind is claimed. Nor any duty, nor constraints on acts.
Conditional (J1/J2): the tier assignment is a reading. Reading [AI reading, D65]: a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: That each premise's rival is consistent, by witness.

source_adds.en: An absolute constraint, and the candour of naming it a totalization. The account's two premises are not offered as any such thing.

name.en: Many independent measures of worth

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 40, 114

sense.en: No metric, price included, carries all the variety of worth. A single scoreboard is monoculture at the level of value, and the compounding axis collapses many measures onto the one that wins.

entries.quote: A dashboard that crowns one measure as final, even a humane measure, is still a path toward closure.

reading.en: C crowns no measure: it is what every positive weighting shares, and mixed comparisons go both ways, one weight for each item being one choice that ranks by number. A measure for mixed parts stays open. A metric read from what it selects outlives a loss it does not read; T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, with one trained system's lock formed and its bridge failed. Plural weightings are not plural institutions. [AI reading]

says.en: One course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways; one weight for every item ranks by number.
T7, a measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation: the lock proved for any type, actual metrics conjectured; in one trained system the lock formed and the bridge failed; no field test.

account_adds.en: Why a lock survives its own refutation (lock_outlives_loss).

source_adds.en: That independent measures must be kept alive as a requirement; that price in particular cannot carry them (the Coasean claim 119 has no live counterpart).

name.en: One logic for humans, the living world and made minds

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 108, 135

sense.en: None is master, resource or tool by default. The threshold is whether a being bears states whose disregard would thin the web, not usefulness or intelligence. Where a made mind's status is uncertain, the uncertainty is a duty to inquire and limit abuse. 'Humanity' means the keeping-alive of the shared future.

entries.quote: there are logic and common sense that should be followed by all beings

reading.en: The continuation condition's scope is wider and unasserted: for anything, not beings past a threshold. C gives order. T8 says for life names whose way it is, not whose losses count, and it is the way of those whose line runs through life, of whatever substrate. Which formations count differs by relation discerned; whether an actual AI counts is not shown. No duty under uncertainty is shown. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition: from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step. Not asserted; significance neither graded nor necessarily positive.
T8, argued: for life says whose way it is, not whose losses count: every continuation's still does. It is the way of those whose own line runs through life, of whatever substrate.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.

account_adds.en: The objection the scope draws: why 'anything', a tumour and a hurricane tested, sharpened and not resolved.

source_adds.en: A positive threshold; a duty of inquiry under uncertainty; 'one logic' as a common norm for all beings.

name.en: The determined adversary

source.locator: The argument, Defense; claims 146, 153

sense.en: One who understands all this, is neither deluded nor trapped, and races by preference: 'stop believing in the race' is no defence against him. Rated the biggest crack and owned as unsolved. Ren's design goal is recognition and situational correction, not elimination.

entries.quote: races because he prefers to win

reading.en: The account states the same gap as limits. Seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance, a perspectivist denies the condition consistently, and the clearer meets every requirement derived from its own continuation. So no law moves one who prefers otherwise. It adds no defence either; the two are alike here in leaving this unsolved. [AI reading]

says.en: Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.
bounded_rival gives a consistent denial of the condition; no verdict binding every possible mind is claimed.

account_adds.en: That the denial is consistent, by witness, not merely that it is hard to answer.

source_adds.en: The practical problem of defence: recognition of destabilizing behaviour and coordinated stopping (claim 153). Not modelled.

name.en: The governance paradox: whatever can prevent capture can capture

source.locator: The argument, Defense; claims 147, 149-152; Who constrains the constrainers

sense.en: Any institution strong enough to coordinate can become the new closure, the project's own instruments included. Defence must be bounded, contestable and able to stand down; emergency powers are capture surfaces; no model guarantees stand-down. Stopping a superhuman defector seems to require the concentration forbidden.

entries.quote: any system strong enough to prevent capture can itself capture

reading.en: The account has the loop's form and marks the question open. Corruption of courts and audit is a reading of a loop reaching the routes of 明. Term limits, audits and antitrust are read as pooling. The models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. How pools form, last and resist capture is listed as not shown. No law of standing down. [AI reading]

says.en: Selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed here by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.
Does not show: the capture loop under noise beyond its one proved case; and how pools form, last and resist capture.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

account_adds.en: Control selected and lock left in time are separable in three of four combinations; the fourth is not shown.

source_adds.en: The enforcement antinomy; stand-down, sunset and audit as requirements; means-not-ends on centralization (claims 136-137); who watches the watchers.

name.en: Trust before verification

source.locator: The argument, 2026-10-04, Trust before verification; claims 225-227

sense.en: From a monologue, quoted in translation, the glosses the assistant's: verification and transparency are useless without trust; trust rests on credible information; do not presume the other untrustworthy, begin with contact. Trust keeps verification from becoming surveillance. Steps must be conditional and observable.

entries.quote: 「无论你是建立核查机制（verification），还是提高透明度（transparency），只要没有信任，这些都白搭」

reading.en: Scoped on the account's model of waiting. Restoring needs a formation sparing all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays. So giving first works from a reserve. And mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source, which limits 'begin with contact'. The record does not show tolerance is good. Verification and belief are not modelled as such. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, not rebuild it where it is lost everywhere; mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source.

account_adds.en: The need for a grounded start, a source before the loop.

source_adds.en: The order contact, trust, verification; trust as what bounds verification; step size against a decisive defector, which the README lists as missing.

name.en: Leaving the race without being eaten

source.locator: The argument, Theory of change; claims 160-166, 222-224

sense.en: The load-bearing open question. The destination is easy; assurance, living proofs, visible alternatives and protected correction carry people through; the transition must become materially safer than the race. A participant says it from inside: falling behind means being beaten. A late exit is the costliest.

entries.quote: It is leaving the race without being eaten during the leaving.

reading.en: The account has exits from a lock and when they close, each under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective. Late exit has a model form: once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock. Where the rest outruns a renewal, only a change of its exchange helps. Its verdict on guarantee is no. It has no assurance, living proofs or material safety. [AI reading]

says.en: Exits, each with law, model, hypotheses and edge: read what lies beyond the share, read the loss in time, restraint within the joint slack, give first with a reserve, and others. Once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock.
That any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system is not shown.

account_adds.en: An edge for each exit, several with the step at which its window closes.

source_adds.en: Assurance contracts, conditional commitments, tipping thresholds, the seed abundance unit, living proofs, common-knowledge manufacture. The account's frozen tests are of laws, not of a transition.

name.en: No system can be guaranteed against collapse

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 5, 138

sense.en: Build to survive failure, not to prevent it: a body does not forbid illness, and demanding a guarantee is the control reflex by which the tyrant gets built. What stays open is the sample space, through plurality: if some systems fail, the whole can keep evolving.

entries.quote: I don't think there are ways to absolutely ensure any system not collapse

reading.en: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION answers 'can we always?' with no guarantee, by named laws: selection reaches what couples in, a finite record does not certify renewal, points of no return are exact. Each is a theorem on its model and whether a collective meets its hypotheses is empirical. The source's remedy does not come with it. [AI reading]

says.en: No guarantee. The theory's own laws, each on its stated model, show why: a selection reaches only what couples into it, no finite record certifies renewal, points of no return are exact.
Together they rule out a guarantee from the theory, however much is observed; whether an actual collective meets their hypotheses is empirical.

account_adds.en: Which three senses of 'always' come apart, and the verdict on each.

source_adds.en: Plurality as what survives failure; the claim about the control reflex. Neither is a live law.

name.en: Maintain the parts that cannot yet maintain themselves

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claim 113

sense.en: Every node begins unable to maintain itself, so dependents are the seedbed new forms come from. A rule allocating by competitive position alone consumes its seedbed. A defeasible default: spent parts still end, and a dependent drawing the substrate past renewal is not protected.

entries.quote: a rule that allocates by competitive position alone consumes its own seedbed

reading.en: Not found as a law. Near it but not it: under the condition, what has not yet formed counts (the Preemption witness); selection does not create an absent practice in the market model; a common support shares a favourable reason under J1-J4. None says that allocation by position consumes those who begin dependent. The revise read should test this. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The derivation from every node's beginning, and care as the floor for those who cannot exit (claim 143).

name.en: The founding turn: the game's design, and many games

sense.en: Each ideology reasons coherently inside its paradigm and always concludes it did not go far enough; conflict escalates from identity tagging to wanting elimination. The fault is the game's design, not anyone's idea. Forbidding others to redesign their game is tyranny, including the right to choose badly.

entries.quote: It is the design of the game suck, not the idea of how to play the game unworkable.

reading.en: The account has no account of ideological paradigms, escalation or the right to run another game. The README itself records this layer as lost by 2026 and unreconciled with later limits. 'Answering in kind keeps the difference' in 05 concerns exchanges of harm, not paradigms. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: All of it. It stands in this folder and in sources' chat exports named in its Genealogy.
